card.name: Just before breast or prostate cancer
card.fires_on: Linking words, spaces or commas right before a likely mention of breast or prostate cancer in drug-label text, e.g. 'patients with', 'Metastases of', or 'Hormone-Refractory Pro'.

modes.label: Linker before prostate cancer
modes.description: A small word like with, receiving or a comma after patients, where prostate cancer terms or its drug names come next.
modes.example: in five patients<< with>> castration-resistant prostate cancer

modes.label: Before Breast Cancer
modes.description: The word of after bone metastases, where Breast Cancer follows.
modes.example: 2.3 Osteolytic Bone Metastases<< of>> Breast Cancer and Osteolytic Les

modes.label: Space after drug name
modes.description: The blank spot after a prostate or breast cancer drug name, before its dose.

card.writes: It boosts breast, prostate and hormone words as the next word.
card.plain: It fires when the label text is about to name breast or prostate cancer.
